columns.name: whatsapp
columns.label: WhatsApp number
columns.help: International format, e.g. +971501234567.

columns.name: trn
columns.label: VAT TRN
columns.help: Your 15-digit Tax Registration Number. Once set, receipts become tax invoices.

columns.name: first_slot
columns.label: First visit starts at
columns.help: 24-hour time, e.g. 08:00.

columns.name: last_slot
columns.label: Last visit starts at
columns.help: 24-hour time, e.g. 18:00.

columns.name: slot_hours
columns.label: Arrival window (hours)
columns.help: Length of each arrival window, e.g. 2 gives 08:00-10:00, 10:00-12:00 and so on.

columns.name: crews_per_slot
columns.label: Crews per arrival window
columns.help: How many visits can start in the same window. Further bookings for it are refused.

columns.name: days_ahead
columns.label: Bookable days ahead
columns.help: Customers can book from today up to this many days ahead.

columns.name: closed_weekday
columns.label: Closed on
columns.help: The weekday without visits, or none.

columns.name: min_order
columns.label: Minimum order (AED)
columns.help: Smallest price of the service itself, before the area surcharge.

columns.name: cancel_hours
columns.label: Free cancellation until (hours before)
columns.help: Customers can cancel online until this many hours before the arrival window starts.

columns.name: unit
columns.label: Priced
columns.help: per_hour: price x hours. per_unit: price x number of units (AC units, rooms, seats). fixed: one price per visit.

columns.name: unit_label
columns.label: Unit name
columns.help: What is counted, e.g. hour, AC unit, room. Not used for fixed prices.

columns.name: materials_price
columns.label: Materials add-on (AED, incl. VAT)
columns.help: Optional extra the customer can tick: charged per hour for hourly services, otherwise once per visit. Leave empty for none.

columns.name: surcharge
columns.label: Surcharge (AED, incl. VAT)
columns.help: Added once per visit in this area. Leave empty for none.

columns.name: active
columns.label: Served
columns.help: Customers can only book in served areas.

columns.name: quantity
columns.label: Quantity
columns.help: Hours or units; 1 for fixed-price services.

columns.name: date
columns.label: Visit date
columns.help: UAE date, YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: slot
columns.label: Arrival from
columns.help: UAE time, HH:MM.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.help: confirmed: waiting for a crew; setting the crew makes it assigned. The crew's page sets on_the_way, in_progress and completed. A change here reaches the customer's booking page at once; cancelled also refunds a card payment and emails the customer.

columns.name: paid
columns.label: Paid
columns.help: Card payment received, or cash collected by the crew.

columns.name: crew_id
columns.label: Crew #
columns.help: The # of the crew in Crews. Setting it marks the booking assigned and emails the customer the crew's first name; then send the crew its link.

columns.name: crew_key
columns.label: Crew key
columns.help: A secret. The crew's link is /crew/<#>?key=<key>; anyone with it can see this job and change its status.

columns.name: repeat_done
columns.label: Next visit handled
columns.help: Set by the daily job once the next visit of a repeating booking was created or skipped.

columns.name: photo
columns.label: Photo of the problem
columns.help: A private photo the customer uploaded with the booking; only the customer and you can open it.

columns.name: refunded
columns.label: Refunded (AED)
columns.help: Refunded to the customer's card when the visit was cancelled.

columns.name: autopay
columns.label: Paid automatically
columns.help: This visit is charged to the card by the automatic payments of its repeating booking.

columns.name: series
columns.label: Automatic payments
columns.help: series-<#>: the automatic card payments of a repeating booking (Payments page). Cancelling all later visits stops them.

columns.name: pay_ref
columns.label: Paid with
columns.help: The card payment that paid this visit (booking-<#> or series-<#>); refunds go to it.

business.name: Bayti Home Services
business.tagline: Cleaning, AC and maintenance across Dubai, booked in a minute
business.tagline_ar: تنظيف وتكييف وصيانة في أنحاء دبي، احجز في دقيقة
business.address: Office 804, Bay Square 3, Business Bay, Dubai

services.name: Home cleaning
services.description: A trained cleaner for regular cleaning: dusting, mopping, kitchen and bathrooms. Minimum 2 hours.
services.description_ar: عاملة تنظيف مدرّبة للتنظيف الدوري: إزالة الغبار ومسح الأرضيات والمطبخ والحمامات. ساعتان على الأقل.

services.name: Deep cleaning (1-bedroom apartment)
services.description: A team of three with machines and materials: floors scrubbed, kitchen degreased, bathrooms descaled, windows inside. About 4 hours.
services.description_ar: فريق من ثلاثة أشخاص مع المعدات والمواد: فرك الأرضيات وإزالة دهون المطبخ وترسبات الحمامات وتنظيف النوافذ من الداخل. نحو 4 ساعات.

services.name: Sofa shampoo cleaning
services.description: Shampoo and extraction cleaning at your home, dry in 4 to 6 hours. Priced per seat, minimum 3 seats.
services.description_ar: تنظيف بالشامبو والشفط في منزلك، يجف خلال 4 إلى 6 ساعات. السعر لكل مقعد، 3 مقاعد على الأقل.

services.name: AC service
services.description: Filter and coil cleaning, drain flush and gas pressure check for split or ducted units.
services.description_ar: تنظيف الفلاتر والملفات وتسليك التصريف وفحص ضغط الغاز لمكيفات السبليت أو المركزية.

services.name: Handyman
services.description: Curtain rods, shelves, TV mounting, door locks and small plumbing or electrical repairs. Parts are charged at cost.
services.description_ar: تركيب الستائر والرفوف وتعليق التلفاز وأقفال الأبواب وإصلاحات السباكة والكهرباء البسيطة. تُحسب قطع الغيار بسعر التكلفة.

services.name: Pest control (apartment)
services.description: Municipality-approved gel and spray treatment for cockroaches and ants, safe for children and pets, with a 30-day guarantee.
services.description_ar: معالجة بالجل والرش معتمدة من البلدية للصراصير والنمل، آمنة للأطفال والحيوانات الأليفة، مع ضمان 30 يوماً.

texts.en: No arrival windows are free on this day. Please choose another date.
texts.ar: لا توجد مواعيد متاحة في هذا اليوم. يرجى اختيار تاريخ آخر.

texts.en: Repeat visits are booked for you automatically at the same time. You pay each visit on completion or by card (or have your card charged automatically), and can cancel any visit online.
texts.ar: تُحجز الزيارات المتكررة لك تلقائياً في الموعد نفسه. تدفع كل زيارة عند الانتهاء أو بالبطاقة (أو تُخصم من بطاقتك تلقائياً)، ويمكنك إلغاء أي زيارة عبر الموقع.

texts.en: e.g. Marina Heights Tower, Al Marsa Street
texts.ar: مثال: برج مارينا هايتس، شارع المرسى

texts.en: Thank you! Your booking is in.
Your crew is on the way. The map follows them live.
texts.ar: الفريق في الطريق إليك. الخريطة تتابعهم مباشرة.

texts.en: Cancel this and all later visits
texts.ar: إلغاء هذه الزيارة وكل الزيارات اللاحقة

texts.en: Free cancellation until {hours} hours before the arrival window.
texts.ar: الإلغاء مجاني حتى {hours} ساعات قبل موعد الوصول.

texts.en: Please choose one of the areas we serve.
texts.ar: يرجى اختيار إحدى المناطق التي نخدمها.

texts.en: Please choose a quantity within the limits of this service.
texts.ar: يرجى اختيار كمية ضمن حدود هذه الخدمة.

texts.en: The minimum order is AED {min}. Please add more.
texts.ar: الحد الأدنى للطلب {min} درهم. يرجى زيادة الكمية.

texts.en: That arrival window is no longer free. Please choose another one.
texts.ar: هذا الموعد لم يعد متاحاً. يرجى اختيار موعد آخر.

texts.en: Please fill in your name, mobile number and address.
texts.ar: يرجى إدخال الاسم ورقم الجوال والعنوان.

texts.en: Card payment is not available right now. Please choose to pay on completion or try later.
texts.ar: الدفع بالبطاقة غير متاح حالياً. يرجى اختيار الدفع عند الانتهاء أو المحاولة لاحقاً.

texts.en: This booking can no longer be cancelled online. Please contact us.
texts.ar: لم يعد بالإمكان إلغاء هذا الحجز عبر الموقع. يرجى التواصل معنا.

texts.en: Open the address in Google Maps

texts.ar: مدفوع مسبقاً: لا يوجد مبلغ للتحصيل

texts.en: Tap On the way when you leave, and keep this page open with the screen on while you drive: the customer sees you on a map.
texts.ar: اضغط «في الطريق» عند الانطلاق وأبقِ هذه الصفحة مفتوحة والشاشة مضاءة أثناء القيادة: يراك العميل على الخريطة.

texts.en: This phone cannot share its location.
texts.ar: هذا الهاتف لا يستطيع مشاركة موقعه.

texts.en: Could not save. Check the connection and try again.
texts.ar: تعذّر الحفظ. تحقق من الاتصال وحاول مرة أخرى.

texts.en: Thank you! The customer and the office have been told.
Your next visit is booked: {service} on {date}
Pay automatically: card charged for each visit, every week
texts.ar: الدفع التلقائي: تُخصم قيمة كل زيارة من البطاقة كل أسبوع

texts.en: Pay automatically: card charged for each visit, every 2 weeks
texts.ar: الدفع التلقائي: تُخصم قيمة كل زيارة من البطاقة كل أسبوعين

texts.en: Paid automatically: your card is charged for each visit. Cancelling this and all later visits stops the payments.
texts.ar: الدفع تلقائي: تُخصم قيمة كل زيارة من بطاقتك. إلغاء هذه الزيارة وكل الزيارات اللاحقة يوقف الخصم.

texts.en: Optional. Only you and our office can see it.
texts.ar: اختياري. لا يراها إلا أنت ومكتبنا.

texts.en: The photo could not be attached. Please choose it again.
texts.ar: تعذّر إرفاق الصورة. يرجى اختيارها مرة أخرى.

texts.en: Photo attached: see the admin panel (ask the office).
texts.ar: توجد صورة مرفقة: في لوحة الإدارة (اسأل المكتب).

texts.en: AED {amount} has been refunded to your card; it can take 5 to 10 days to appear.
texts.ar: تم استرداد {amount} درهم إلى بطاقتك، وقد يستغرق ظهوره من 5 إلى 10 أيام.

templates.css:
<style>
:root{--bg:#f4f8f7;--fg:#14211f;--muted:#5b6b68;--card:#fff;--line:#dbe6e3;--accent:#0b7a6b;--accent-fg:#fff;--soft:#e0f1ee}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#0f1514;--fg:#e9f1ef;--muted:#9baca8;--card:#182120;--line:#2a3835;--accent:#4fd1b8;--accent-fg:#06211c;--soft:#1c302c}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg)}
a{color:inherit}header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000}
.brand{font-weight:700;font-size:18px;text-decoration:none}nav{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;font-size:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
main{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 16px 80px}h1{font-size:26px;line-height:1.2;margin:12px 0 8px}h2{font-size:18px;margin:24px 0 10px}
.hero{padding:20px 0 4px}.hero h1{font-size:32px}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:12px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;text-decoration:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.card .img{aspect-ratio:16/9;background:var(--line)}.card img,.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.card .body{padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1}.card p{margin:0;flex:1}.price{font-weight:700}
.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:8px 0 16px}.chip{padding:4px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;font-size:14px;background:var(--card)}
button,.btn{display:inline-block;padding:12px 18px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-fg);font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;text-align:center}
button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}button.secondary{background:transparent;color:var(--fg);border:1px solid var(--line)}.small{padding:6px 12px;font-size:14px;align-self:flex-start}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);font:inherit}
label{display:block;margin:14px 0 4px;font-size:14px}label.check{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:16px}label.check input{width:auto}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:6px 0}.total{font-weight:700;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:10px}
.panel{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:16px}.panel h2{margin-top:0}
.error{color:#c62828}.ok{color:#2e7d32;font-size:18px}.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}@media(min-width:760px){.two{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:start}}
.photo{aspect-ratio:16/9;background:var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}.sum{background:var(--soft);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin:16px 0}
.slots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:8px}.slot{margin:0;position:relative}.slot input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0}
.slot span{display:block;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;text-align:center;background:var(--card);cursor:pointer;font-size:15px}
.slot input:checked+span{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-fg);border-color:var(--accent)}.slot input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.slot.off span{opacity:.4;text-decoration:line-through;cursor:default}.badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--soft);color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
#map{height:340px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);margin:12px 0 4px}.cash{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}.stack button{width:100%;margin-top:10px;padding:16px}button.done{background:#1f8a4c;color:#fff}
.wa{position:fixed;bottom:16px;inset-inline-end:16px;background:#25d366;color:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:10px 16px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;z-index:1000}
</style>

tools.description: This home-service company's services (cleaning, AC, pest control, handyman) with prices in AED (VAT included), how each is priced (per hour, per unit or fixed), quantity limits, the areas served with their surcharge, and the page where the customer books.

params.name: lang
params.description: en (default) or ar for Arabic names

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: The arrival windows of one date (UAE time) and how many crews are still free in each. Booking and payment happen on the website.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The exact price of a visit: service, quantity (hours or units), area surcharge and the VAT included, as the booking form charges it.

params.name: quantity
params.description: hours or units; leave out for fixed-price services or the minimum

params.name: area
params.description: area name or id from list_services, e.g. Dubai Marina

params.name: materials

tools.description: The company's working hours, closed day, areas served, minimum order, cancellation rule, payment methods (card, cash on completion) and WhatsApp contact.
